contracts_rationale: No API or schema is published; the mission removes the legacy docsite toolchain, and its interfaces are the tests and workflow steps it changes.
purpose_context: The docsite cutover (#6938) moved the deploy to the doc-kitty build; no CI job builds DocFX any more. This mission removes docs/docfx.json, every toc.yml, the DocFX template, the scripts ADR D-6 marks drop (and port scripts whose job doc-kitty now does), and the redirect map and manifest the ledgers superseded. Tests that guard a still-live invariant, such as which pages are published or that docs/reports is never published, are rebased on scripts/docs/_dockitty_contract.py. The operator waived the one-release gate; rollback becomes reverting this PR and #7558.
purpose_tldr: Remove DocFX, its config, template and DocFX-only scripts, and rebase the tests that guard live invariants on the doc-kitty contract (#6943)
